settings.label: Require Approval for New Lines
settings.desc: When on, new work order lines require approval. When off, they are auto-approved.

settings.label: Require Review Before Completion
settings.desc: Work orders must be reviewed and signed off before they can be completed

settings.label: Require Tech Story
settings.desc: Tech story will be a required field before a line can be completed on a work order

settings.label: Require Mileage
settings.desc: Mileage will be a required field before a line can be completed on a work order

settings.label: Require Engine Hours
settings.desc: Engine hours will be a required field before a line can be completed on a work order

settings.label: Require Ordering Parts
settings.desc: When on, you click Order on each part to record that you've ordered it. When off, parts are marked as ordered automatically.

settings.label: Require Receiving Parts Before Completion
settings.desc: When on, each part must be recorded as received before the work order can be completed, reviewed or invoiced. When off, you can finish the work order and receive later.

settings.label: Require Picking Inventory Parts
settings.desc: When on, you click Pick on each inventory and found part to record that it's been pulled. When off, these parts are ready as soon as the line is approved.
